d:
In this enlightening episode, we delve deeply into the powerful theme of **renunciation** through the inspiring and selfless journey of **Madhvacharya**. His commitment to his nation and people, placing the welfare of the nation over his personal gains, beautifully illustrates the essence of **selfless service** and **spiritual dedication**. Set against the backdrop of the **Vijayanagar Empire**, the story of **Swami Vidyaranya** serves as a vivid representation of renunciation as a means of pursuing a higher purpose in life.
• Available in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam & Hindi**
